Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai

Interface RoutingPolicy

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface RoutingPolicy
The app's say in which job a model takes. Jobs are bound to a model as late as possible: when one of the model's slots is free and the model may send (its own and its gateway's limits allow, nothing holds it back), the hub offers the slot every waiting job that may run on the model, and the policy picks one, or none to leave the slot idle for now. A slow model frees its slots less often, so the other models of a root take more of the work.

Called under the hub's lock: be quick, and don't call back into the hub (use view). An exception is logged and the slot takes the first candidate in order instead.
